Marketing Coordinator Co-op

Company: Glassmere Interiors
Location: Halifax, NS
Work Arrangement: Hybrid
Work Term: Winter 2028
Duration: 4 months

About Glassmere Interiors

Glassmere Interiors was founded in 2011 and now operates six showrooms across Atlantic
Canada. Our current brand campaign launched on March 3, 2027.

Timeline

Interviews will be held the week of November 8, 2027.
The anticipated start date is January 4, 2028.
New hire orientation runs January 11, 2028.

Responsibilities

- Support brand marketing campaigns across print and digital channels
- Coordinate photography for seasonal showroom launches
- Maintain the marketing content calendar

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled.
